newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start easier on renewed U.S. rate fears.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start easier on renewed U.S. rate fears.

text.p: Leading UK shares started easier on Wednesday after renewed interest rate jitters put the brakes on Wall Street's recent surge and gave the London market the chance to mark prices lower, traders said.

The FTSE 100 opened down 6.9 points at 3,965.4 with early decliners leading advancers by 55 to 17. Business was expected to continue at the modest levels of recent sessions with early activity capped by August UK retail sales data at 0830 GMT.
Economists forecast a 0.5 percent rise for the month and 3.5 percent year-on-year.
